en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a village street leading to a large stone church with a tall square bell tower, clock, and steep roof. A horse‑drawn cart and a man stand in the street in front of the church. Residential buildings line the right side. Printed French text at the top identifies the location as the church in Davenescourt, in the environs of Montdidier. There is a handwritten date or note in ink near the top.
